metas.name: 67C Yellow Lines
metas.note: The 67C is a mountain road with all yellow road lines.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: 7C Road
metas.note: The 7C is recognisable as going through some of the most dramatic mountains in Romania, with very green and lush vegetation. It also has distinct long and spiraling roads.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Baia Mare House Numbers
metas.note:
In the city of Baia Mare those distinct red with white outline house numbers are common.

**Note: **They were introduced in 2024 so won't be found in earlier copyrights.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Baia Mare Street Signs
metas.note:
In the city of Baia Mare those distinct red with white outline street signs are common. They can be in the surrounding towns as well, thought usually the red will be replaced by another color.

**Note: **They were introduced in 2024 so won't be found in earlier copyrights.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Bilingual Signs
metas.note: Bilingual signs with Hungarian are mostly found in the central regions of Covasna, Harghita and Mureş, but also less commonly near the Hungarian border.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Bucharest Street Sign
metas.note: Street signs in Bucharest will often have written "sector" on them which means "district" and can be found within the city. Sometimes the sign can look very similar to the Paris street sign: big, blue and with a green outline.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Buzău Street Sign
metas.note: Street signs in Buzău will often have this logo on them resembling the letter B.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Cluj Napoca Stickers
metas.note: The city of Cluj has those vertical white stickers of 3 numbers and a letter.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Constanța Street Sign
metas.note: Street signs in Constanța will often be white with a black,thin border but will also have this distinct logo on them.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Eastern Pole Sticker
metas.note: In north-east Romania the yellow stickers on the poles are usually very long. The name of the town/village can often be found in the middle of the sticker.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Maramureș Wooden Gate
metas.note: Elaborately decorated wooden gates can be found in Maramureș, in the North-West
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Metal/Fake Tiled Roofs
metas.note: In the eastern half of Romania, it is very common to have plastic fake tiled or metal roofs. As well as the roofs seem to have more diverse colors. If most roofs you see are metal or plastic fake tiled, you are likely in the eastern half. In the center there is a combination of different roof types
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/romania.

metas.name: North-West Pole Stickers
metas.note:
In north-west Romania you can find those red electricity warning which are on a white background. In the rest of the country the background is mostly yellow. The North-West region can also have yellow background on the warning sign

Note: You can find similar sticks in other regions but it's by far the most common in the north-west
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Orange Tiled Roofs
metas.note: In the western half of Romania, it is very common to have orange tiled roofs. If most roofs you see are orange tiled, you are likely in the western half. In the center there is a combination of different roof types
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/romania.

metas.name: Orange Vertical Stickers
metas.note:
Orange vertical pole stickers with numbers on them can be found in Bucharest, Galati, Iasi, Piatra Neamt, Baia Mare and Craiova.

Note: In Iasi the sticker is 6 digits long, in the other cities it is usually 5 digits long.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Sibiu squinting eye
metas.note: The city of Sibiu often has those windows at roof level which look like a squinting eye.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/romania.

metas.name: South Stickers
metas.note:
In south-center Romania there are often stickers on poles that can give the region away.

Besides the well known rectangle stickers, within the south of Romania there are also those brown E stickers and also green D stickers.

Note: The stickers can be used interchangeably, if you see any one of those stickers then it is that region.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Southern Pole sticker
metas.note: In south-center Romania there are often small green rectangles. If they can be read, the first 2 letters are abbreviation of the county you are in.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Timisoara QR Stickers
metas.note: Within Timisoara a lot of the poles have those vertical stickers with 5 numbers and a QR code at the top.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Transylvania Roof Crosses
metas.note:
In Transylvania it's not uncommon to see crosses on top of the roof, the darker areas are where there is a very high concentration of roof crosses and the lighter areas it's still common but you might have to move a bit to find them. This meta can slightly "bleed" into the neighboring counties around the border. In Maramures county a variant of the cross can be found with an arch above it!

Note: It is extremely rare to find crosses on roofs outside of those areas, so rare that I'm not sure they exist since I didn't find any.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Using County Signs
metas.note:
Fairly often you'll see those big signs which usually are blue or white and can tell you exactly where you are.

Some useful words

  • Județ(abbreviated as jud.) - County (can be read while zooming in the dotted lines)
  • Municipiul - City
  • Localitate - City
  • Comună/Sat - Village
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Using KM Markers
metas.note: Often on the side of the road KM markers can be found in different colors (red, blue, yellow, white) and the color should also represent the color the road will show up on the map. On the side is the road number and usually on the front are two cities, the first one is the closest largest city and the second one is the closest town.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Wind Farms
metas.note: Wind turbine farms can be found in the very east of Romania in the counties of Constanța and Tulcea, as well as in the west.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.
